# The crates from outside Fennec that its runtime library names itself, with what each is for.
# The runtime ships inside every Fennec program, so each is in every program anyone builds, with
# everything it brings. `.github/scripts/runtime-crates.sh` fails when the runtime's own crates
# name one that isn't here, or stop naming one that is, so adding a crate to every program is
# seen in the pull request that does it. CI's `deny` job holds every crate in the runtime's graph
# to no advisory of any kind, where the rest of the workspace has only vulnerabilities fail.
#
# crate | what the runtime uses it for
cap-primitives | an `fs` narrowed again going down to its folder one folder at a time, following no link (cap-std's own base, already under it)
cap-std | `fs` narrowed to a folder, with no way out of it
corosensei | a parked task's own stack (through fennec-parked)
crossbeam-deque | `parallel`'s work-stealing pool
ctrlc | Ctrl-C on Windows
getrandom | `Entropy`
libm | float functions with the same bits on every system
mimalloc | the allocator
mio | waiting on sockets, for parked tasks and servers
nix | waking a parked `process.run` when its program ends, through kqueue's process events on macOS (#1837)
rusqlite | `std.sqlite`
rustix | system calls on Unix
rustls | TLS
rustls-platform-verifier | the system's own certificates, for TLS
same-file | telling whether two paths are one file, for `fs` and SQLite
signal-hook | signals on Unix
socket2 | a server's listen queue as long as the system allows, and on Windows a socket's send buffer size
